title: Text: DET Courtney Foyt ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: I went to Malta for a month and it was pretty sweet
Just got back yesterday, passed out on the couch watching this hearing, my internal clock is all messed up
Oh shoot that’s awesome! Did you stay in Malta the whole time or did you do some additional traveling?
Essentially it was my base, I went up to Sicily for 4 days and then Serbia for 3 days
I stayed with family there, so that’s why I could stay for so long
Amazing. You’ll have to show me some pictures. That’s gotta be some terrible jet lag though
When I got off the plane yesterday, I met with an ex-Tigers ticket employee. We need to talk about this story I’m doing!
Oh shoot. I’m here for it!
My uncle’s family is from Malta. The last name Spiteri sound familiar?
My aunt (marries in as a Spiteri) is over right now. Wanted to know who your relatives are in Malta?
